create_multilayer_eagle_draft_worker: create a MultiLayerEagleDraftWorker instance to run speculative token draft with multiple layers and top-k sampling
create_multilayer_eagle_worker_v2: create a MultiLayerEagleWorkerV2 instance that coordinates draft and target workers for speculative decoding
run_draft_forward: run the draft forward pass to generate top-k candidate tokens across multiple speculative steps
run_draft_extend_for_prefill: run draft extend during prefill to fill KV cache using target model hidden states and next token ids
run_verify: run target model verification of draft tokens and sample accepted tokens with logprob computation
